what: Declarations for the provenance chain, written and committed BEFORE scripts/provenance.py existed or any step was built. The commit that adds this file is the pre-run commit; every step carries it as declared_pre_run. A later change is a new dated entry under 'amendments', never an edit.

paths.void_states: experiments/experiment_bridge/v1/README.md lines 16-20, v1/semantics.py, eqsearch/exact.py at main e8b7d12
paths.snapshot_classes: experiments/experiment_bridge/snapshot/README.md and snapshot/snapshot_class.py on branch claude/snapshot-class at baa114e2eecec3c8e8a30c388039f6cc2f4ec5d6 (not on main at e8b7d12)

hash.canonical_json: UTF-8; keys sorted; separators ',' and ':' with no spaces; non-ASCII characters written as themselves; no trailing newline
hash.step_id: sha256 of the canonical JSON of {inputs, method, params, value}
hash.source_id: 'S-' + first 12 hex of sha256 of the source string as UTF-8
hash.assumption_id: 'A-' + first 12 hex of sha256 of the statement as UTF-8

backfill.params: entity id and field path always; for attributes also evidence_type and reproducibility as found
backfill.inputs: the source ids of the field's source strings, in the order found; [] when the field has none
backfill.status: the field's existing status tag, or null when it has none; no tag is assigned by the backfill
backfill.assumptions: the ids of the entity's assumption_trace on the coordination.assumption_trace step only; [] elsewhere
backfill.no_new_claims: claim is null on every backfilled step

stale_rules.HASH_MISMATCH: a stored step id differs from the id recomputed from the stored step
stale_rules.SOURCE_CHANGED: an input source id is missing from registry/sources.json, or its text no longer hashes to its id
stale_rules.ASSUMPTION_CHANGED: an assumption id on the step is missing from registry/assumptions.json, is superseded by a later entry, or its statement no longer hashes to its id
stale_rules.FIELD_CHANGED: the head step of a field differs from the step computed now from the entity file
stale_rules.INPUT_CHANGED: a parent step named in inputs is flagged by any rule above or has been superseded; applied transitively

revision_rule: Nothing is deleted or edited. A revision appends a new step whose supersedes is the prior step id. A superseded step stays in the file. An appended step whose id already exists in the file is refused.

mapping.LEXICAL_VOID: the field is null and the record states the gap in words (a note such as 'unmeasured', or a notes entry for the field)
mapping.VOID: the field is null and no reason is recorded
mapping.UNMAPPED: the field has a value and no source at all
mapping.REJECTED: a value was offered and refused by a gate; none is produced by the backfill

void_states.shape: void is null, or {state, reason}; a step with a void state for a null field has value null

snapshot_classes.use: a field on any summarized or coarse record; null on a record that is not a summary
snapshot_classes.provenance/INDEX.json: SUMMARY_ONLY (per-entity counts; the steps cannot be rebuilt from it)

thresholds: none: the chain has no numeric gate

amendments.after: the first build (commit 9d4b56f, 303 steps) and the owner's answers to the step-0 questions
amendments.what: Rules changed by order before any use of the chain. The text above is kept as first declared; where it differs, this entry governs.

changes.step_id: sha256 of the canonical JSON of {inputs, method, params, value}, unchanged in form; params now always holds entity, field and entity_file_sha256 (sha256 of the entity file's bytes), so the id covers entity file hash + field path + value
changes.source_id: the full sha256 (64 hex) of the exact source string as UTF-8; no prefix. Registry fields: id, string, same_as (null), opened (false or a depth word), fetched (null or a date)
changes.assumptions_on_attribute_steps: null = not assessed; never []. [] is used only where a block field was read and names none
changes.status_note: new step key, not in the id. Attribute steps carry status null and status_note 'not assessed in this vocabulary'
changes.schema: schemas/provenance_step.schema.json validates files under provenance/. No entity schema references it and no entity file carries a provenance key
changes.declared_pre_run: steps cite the latest commit that changed this file before the build, which is the commit adding this amendment
changes.first_build: the 303 steps and the source registry of the first build are kept unchanged under provenance/v0_superseded/ and registry/v0_superseded/; they are not part of the live chain
changes.FIELD_CHANGED_consequence: because the id covers the entity file hash, any byte change to an entity file gives every field of that entity a new step
